name: Agency delivery
description: Client brief -> isolated workspace -> execution -> client review. Produces approved deliverables without other-client context.

steps.title: Scope brief for {{client}}
steps.acceptance: Criteria measurable; scope limited to this client workspace.
steps.instructions: Turn the brief for {{client}} into measurable acceptance criteria. Use only this workspace's context.

steps.title: Deliver {{deliverable}} for {{client}}
steps.acceptance: Deliverable meets the criteria; no cross-client context used.
steps.instructions: Produce {{deliverable}} for {{client}} within this workspace only.

steps.title: QA {{deliverable}} for {{client}}
steps.instructions: Check {{deliverable}} against every acceptance criterion and record evidence.

steps.title: Client review of {{deliverable}}
steps.instructions: Present {{deliverable}} and the QA report to {{client}} for approval.
